import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(file_path="data.csv", columns=["A", "B", "C"]):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

    # Convert numeric-looking columns to floats while preserving non-numeric columns.
    for col in df.columns:
        converted = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="ignore")
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(converted):
            df[col] = converted.astype(float)

    # Prepare the plot.
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    plotted = False
    for col in columns:
        if col in df.columns:
            series = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").astype(float)
            df[col] = series
            if series.notna().any():
                ax.plot(series.index, series.values, label=col)
                plotted = True

    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_title("Line Chart")
    if plotted:
        ax.legend()

    # Compute cube-root of all numeric data in the DataFrame.
    numeric_values = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).to_numpy().ravel()
    cube_root_series = pd.Series(np.cbrt(numeric_values), name="cube_root")

    return df, ax, cube_root_series
